title: ADR-0093 D9: record that a host candidate list keeps the default active organization out (objectstack#35829)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

**Drift.** ADR-0093 D9 (summary at line 66, decision section at line 570) says plugin-auth's default stamps `activeOrganizationId` from membership "only when the draft lacks one". Since PR #35913 (merge `cf7e44394032`, Fixes #35829), the default also stays out when the host's `session.create.before` returns an `activeOrganizationCandidates` list, even if the draft lacks an organization. With `autoActiveOrganization: false`, the host's candidate list is still honoured.

**Where the shipped wording already is:**
- the `autoActiveOrganization` JSDoc in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`;
- the `SessionCreateBeforeResult` docblock in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/session-organization-candidates.ts`.

**Fix shape.** One recording edit to D9, under both headings, stating the candidate-list case. Per D9's own framing this is a recording, not a new ruling. `docs/adr/**` is governed (Tier H), so a human merges it.

Found by: the seat's review of PR #35913. The dev named it in the PR's Acceptance notes. The seat left the ADR unedited in that PR because the path is governed.

Re-check: `grep -n "only when the draft lacks one" docs/adr/0093-*.md` hits ⇒ drift still present.
